items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Double cream (45% fat or more)' to USDA Foundation 'Cream, heavy' through a retained exact evidence record. The destination explicitly identifies double cream, a high-fat fluid dairy cream, so heavy cream is the appropriate reviewed USDA family rather than light cream, sour cream, cream cheese, or a cream-based prepared dish. Confidence remains medium because British/European double cream is typically around 45–48% fat while USDA heavy cream is commonly lower in fat, so the record is a close nutrient-profile approximation within the same plain high-fat cream family; this decision does not generalize to vague thick cream, cooking cream, crème fraîche, plant-based cream, or flavored cream.
